title: On Beginning the climb before light
subtitle: 努力坚持 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 努力坚持（人与自我·做人与做事·努力与坚持）
meta: 主题语境：努力坚持（人与自我·做人与做事·努力与坚持）　|　核心词汇：begin　|　正文 332 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 begin 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the trader ① began the climb before light in public, and every partner in the market said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the trader ② begins the climb before light in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ begin the climb before light at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ begun the climb before light before — a line in the list for October 1983 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Beginning the climb before light in public, the trader said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the basket at the far stall, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ begin as a joke over supper in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Begin as a joke over supper at once and never mention it again.

By 1996 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the list, and a new partner from the next market ⑧ begins as a joke over supper in public every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stall, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ began the climb before light again when nobody else would.

⑩ To begin the climb before light, my mother said in 2001, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the market remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the market forgets, somebody begins the climb before light in silence again and somebody must begin the climb before light in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 开始（一般过去式 began the climb before light：1989 年货商头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 开始（一般现在 begins the climb before light：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 开始（不定式 to begin the climb before light：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 开始（过去完成时 had begun the climb before light：1983 年十月的货单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 开始（动名词 beginning the climb before light 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 始于（begin as a joke over supper：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去始于晚饭桌上的一句玩笑）
G. v. 始于（begin as a joke over supper：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 开始（后段两处：新来的伙计照例 begins as a joke over supper，而母亲又一次 began the climb before light）

items.q: to begin the climb before light
begun the climb before light before
begin as a joke over supper in silence
begin as a joke over supper at once
begins as a joke over supper in public
began the climb before light again
to begin the climb before light

answers.why: begin 意为“开始”，1989 年货商当着众人面开始天还没亮就动身攀登，那是集市里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 began。
begin 意为“开始”，自那以后货商一言不发地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 begins。
begin 意为“开始”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯开始天还没亮就动身攀登”，此处为不定式 to begin the climb before light。
begin 意为“开始”，货单里 十月 那行字说明早在 1996 年之前就有人开始过，故用过去完成时 had begun。
begin 意为“开始”，货商说“开始天还没亮就动身攀登这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 beginning the climb before light 作主语。
begin 意为“始于”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去始于晚饭桌上的一句玩笑”，should ever 之后用原形 begin as a joke over supper。
begin 意为“始于”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻始于晚饭桌上的一句玩笑（begin as a joke over supper at once），以后再也不要提起。
begin 意为“开始”，新来的伙计每个星期都照例始于晚饭桌上的一句玩笑，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 begins。
begin 意为“开始”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当着众人面开始天还没亮就动身攀登，用一般过去式 began 叙述。
begin 意为“开始”，结尾那句是母亲 2001 年的话：要开始天还没亮就动身攀登，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和集市记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1989 年，货商当着众人面开始天还没亮就动身攀登；集市里每一个伙计都说这是头一回。（began the climb before light）
多年以后，货商仍一言不发地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（begins the climb before light）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯开始天还没亮就动身攀登这件事本身。（to begin the climb before light）
早在 1983 年就有人开始天还没亮就动身攀登，十月那天货单上的一行字就是证据。（had begun the climb before light）
货商说过，当着众人面开始天还没亮就动身攀登这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（beginning the climb before light 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻始于晚饭桌上的一句玩笑，以后再也不要提起。（begin as a joke over supper，祈使句）
answers: In 1989 the trader began the climb before light in public, and every partner in the market said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three weeks on, the trader still begins the climb before light in silence without being asked.
My mother said later that to begin the climb before light at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had begun the climb before light long before 1996, and the line in the list for October proves it.
Beginning the climb before light in public, the trader said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Begin as a joke over supper at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 begin 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1989 the trader began the climb before light in public, and nobody in the market forgot it.
Even now the trader begins the climb before light in silence whenever the market asks.
Beginning the climb before light in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever begin as a joke over supper in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new partner from the next market begins as a joke over supper in public every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother began the climb before light again, and the market remembered that half.
